scope: Controlled fault injection: Nitrado circuit OPEN, SSRF, path traversal, idempotency store-down pin, AI/Nitrado retry contracts, scope no-bypass, and real PostgreSQL/Redis service-container process-kill with bounded failure and recovery.

contracts.dockerProcessKillHarness: scripts/stage59-process-kill-chaos.ts executed twice by .github/workflows/stage59-chaos.yml on isolated GitHub runners with real PostgreSQL and Redis service containers
contracts.postgresFailure: The existing Prisma runtime must reject within a bounded window while the PostgreSQL container is stopped
contracts.postgresRecovery: The same Prisma runtime must query successfully again after the same PostgreSQL service container restarts
contracts.redisFailure: The connected Redis client must reject within a bounded window while the Redis container is stopped
contracts.redisRecovery: Redis must become usable again after the same Redis service container restarts
contracts.currentMainBinding: Stage 59 evidence is rebound to audited main 7ca09272eb583dbaa3bbcc7433032ce7f11098de; runtime artifacts bind each CI execution to the exact PR/main SHA
